items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Zawinul, Herbie and Chick are all on that

ctx.x: And then the next recording in the discography is the Miles Davis session. The “Directions” session and that was actually November not September as I said earlier. And you’re correct: Joe Zawinul, Herbie and Chick are all on that so it looks like the precursor to “Bitches Brew.” It’s also crediting Teo Macero with playing percussion. Do you recall that?
I don’t know, I don’t remember that. Maybe, I don’t know maybe he was. I thought he was in the control room.
